3700:

**Qal** **for the work of thy hands thou wouldest long**; **like a lion that longeth to rend**.
**Niph**. **thou didst long sorely for thy father’s house**
3701:

**2.** silver as bright, shining
**3.** silver, as wealth
**4.** silver as spoil of war
**5.** silver as merchandise
**6.** silver as costly gift
**7.** silver as material
**8.** silver as measure of weight and value
**9.** among vbs. and phr.
3707:

**Qal**
**1.** **be vexed**, **indignant**
**2.** **be angry**
**Piel**. **provoke to anger**
**Hiph**.
**1.** **vex**
**2.** **vex**, **provoke to anger**
3709: כַּף 192 _n.f_. **hollow**, or **flat of the hand**, **palm**, **sole of foot**, **hand**
3713: כְּפוֹר _n.m_. **bowl** of gold or silver, used in the temple (late)
3714: כָּפִיס _n.m_. appar. term. techn. for some beam in a house, perhaps **rafter**, or **girder**;—only [[35-habakkuk.2.11|Hb 2:11]]
3715: כְּפִירִים [[16-nehemiah.6.2|Ne 6:2]], prob. = foregoing [כְּפִירָה] (𝔊 al. n. appell. = **villages**).
3716: כְּפִירָה _n.pr.loc_. city of the Hivites subsequently assigned to Benjamin.
3717:
כָּפַל _vb_. **double**, **double over** (late)
**Qal** **and thou shalt double over** the sixth curtain, i.e. prob. use it double; **folded double**, of the breast-piece
**Niph**. **and let** the sword **be doubled**, but very dub.
3721:
כָּפַף _vb_. **bend**, **bend down**, **be bent**, **bowed**
**Qal** **my soul is bowed down**
**Niph**. with what **shall I bow myself** (in worship) **toward the high God?**
3722:
כִּפֶּר _vb_. **Pi**. etc. _denom_. **cover over** (fig.), **pacify**, **make propitiation**
**Pi**.
**1.** **cover over**, **pacify**, **propitiate**
**2.** **cover over**, **atone for sin**, without sacrifice
**3.** **cover over**, **atone for sin and persons by legal rites**
**Pu**. **be covered over**, **atoned for**
**Hithp**. **the iniquity of the house of Eli shall not be covered by peace-offering or minchah**
**Niph**. **and the blood shall be covered for them**
כָּפַר _vb. denom_. [[01-genesis.6.14|Gn 6:14]] **and thou shalt pitch it with pitch** (P).
3723: [כָּפָר] _n.m_. **village**;—sg. cstr. כְּפַר הָעַמּוֹנִי [[06-joshua.18.24|Jos 18:24]] Kt **village of the Ammonites**
3724: כֹּ֫פֶר _n.m_. name of a plant, **El Ḥenna**
3726: [כָּפָר] _n.m_. **village**;—sg. cstr. כְּפַר הָעַמּוֹנִי [[06-joshua.18.24|Jos 18:24]] Kt **village of the Ammonites**
